title: Curious Baby Resting on Knitted Blankets, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A close-up black-and-white snapshot captures an infant resting comfortably amid soft, textured blankets, including a hand-knitted afghan. The baby looks upward with wide, inquisitive dark eyes and a relaxed expression. This image reflects the post-war mid-century rise of everyday family photography, documenting quiet domestic milestones in the comfort of home.
